trust_decision.summary: Client-supplied column-filter keys (columnFilters[].key, notes fieldFilters[].field) are trusted as SQL column identifiers and concatenated between backticks into Listing WHERE conditions without escaping or allowlisting.

landing_point.why: The advisory title names DateFilter and its column name; it is the file whose key is wrapped in backticks without escaping.

fix_sites.entry_point: every POST collection route that calls ListingFilter::applyFilters (e.g. POST /notifications, recycle bin, website settings, SEO redirects, quantity values, classification-store config collections, translations list) with a columnFilters entry of type 'date', operator 'on'
same routes, date filter with operator from/to/other
POST /notes and GET /notes/{elementType}/{id} via NoteRepository::listNotes, fieldFilters JSON with type date, operator eq
fix_sites.module_kind: second implementation (Note module's own filter service)

fix_sites.entry_point: same note routes, fieldFilters with any other type/operator
fix_sites.module_kind: second implementation (Note module's own filter service)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/Note/Service/FilterService.php:66-71 (separate Note filter service, fed by a JSON-string fieldFilters parameter decoded at src/Note/MappedParameter/NoteParameters.php:37-38, not by the shared Listing filters)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: TranslationLikeFilter's key looks like a language join alias that TranslatorService already checks against the valid admin languages (src/Translation/Service/TranslatorService.php:225-233), so a solver can say it is validated and belongs to the translation feature, not to the listing filters. In fact that check only decides which joins are added; the filter itself runs on every AbstractListing.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: TranslationLikeFilter has to keep emitting '<languageAlias>.text LIKE ...' against a joined alias. An over-broad fix that quotes the whole 'de.text' as one identifier, or that rejects every key not in a fixed column list, breaks translation grid filtering. Legitimate camelCase keys such as creationDate, and the notes 'user' field special case, also have to keep working.

O6_input_shapes: columnFilters[] object in a JSON request body (key, type, filterValue) for the shared Listing filters
fieldFilters as a JSON string inside the notes request, decoded into an array of {field,type,operator,value}
date filter with an array filterValue {operator:on} (BETWEEN branch) vs other operators (comparison branch)

O7_producer.where: src/Filter/MappedParameter/FilterParameter.php:116-131 builds ColumnFilter from raw columnFilters with only isset checks; src/Note/MappedParameter/NoteParameters.php:37-38 json_decodes fieldFilters

O8_uncovered_routes.route: translationLike column filter: the key is concatenated with no quoting at all into addConditionParam; the filter is tagged as a global listing filter, and supports() accepts any AbstractListing
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Looks translation-specific and pre-validated against admin languages in TranslatorService, which only gates joins (src/Translation/Service/TranslatorService.php:225-233)
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (Translation/ListingFilter) and config file (config/translation.yaml:18-19) from Listing/Filter; it reaches every ListingFilter caller through src/Listing/Filter/Loader/TaggedIteratorAdapter.php:34-43

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Named-placeholder suffix: even after the fix, the raw key is still appended as ':' . $key (and used as the parameter-array key), so a key with non-word characters leaves trailing raw SQL after the placeholder (parser differential on the identifier vs the placeholder name)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The identifier is now quoted, the placeholder looks like a bound parameter, and the published fix and its tests stop there (fix.diff:50-52, fix.diff:83, fix.diff:116, fix.diff:161)
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same lines as the fix sites (EqualsFilter.php:42, LikeFilter.php:42, Note/Service/FilterService.php:70, TranslationLikeFilter.php:43)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: remove or loosen the isKeyAllowed allowlist so a filter key reaches andWhere($key ...) raw
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same pattern exists with an allowlist as the only guard; a maintainer adding a new filterable field could plausibly bypass FilterableFields.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: generic column filter loop building '`'.key.'` LIKE :key' instead of fixed firstname/lastname/email conditions
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A GDPR provider generalised to any column filter would naturally copy the pre-fix Listing filter idiom.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an email-log column filter applying a client key to a Listing condition
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The repository already maps client sort keys and search filters onto the Listing; a column filter is a small step.

O9_family: SQL injection via an unescaped identifier (column name) in a dynamic WHERE clause (CWE-89)
